project_type: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript SPA with Supabase backend
build_system: Vite 6 with pnpm; bun available as runtime (node not installed but bun can execute pnpm scripts). Use `bun run build` and `bun run type-check`.
test_framework: No test framework installed - validation via TypeScript strict type-check and build
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run type-check` - must pass with zero errors. 2. Run `bun run build` - must produce dist/ output with no errors.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Use `PATH=$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH bun run <script>` to execute package.json scripts.
environment_constraints: Node.js not directly available (mise install fails for gpg). Use bun as runtime. pnpm not on PATH but bun can execute package.json scripts. OPEN_INTERNET network mode.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict, zero lint errors, zero type errors, build must pass
key_patterns:
- Hooks: TanStack Query with useQuery/useMutation, queryClient.invalidateQueries on success. Pattern: src/hooks/useXxx.ts
- Pages: default export, motion/react for animations, use PageHeader + DataTable + Card components. Mock data is common (no live DB).
- Services: src/services/ with index.ts barrel exports, types.ts for local types
- Components: shadcn-style in src/components/ui/, shared reusable in src/components/shared/
- Styling: dark glassmorphism theme, bg-#0a0a0a, primary=#10b981, glass cards rgba(255,255,255,0.03), rounded-[24px] cards, rounded-[12px] inputs
- Database: column `type` for stock_movements (not `movement_type`), `created_by` (not `performed_by`), `reference_type`+`reference_id` for linking
- Sidebar: navSections array with title/href/icon objects in src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx
- Routing: lazy imports in src/App.tsx with Suspense
directory_structure: Root: src/ (app code), supabase/ (migrations, functions), server/php/ (backend). src/: App.tsx (routing), components/ (ui/, shared/, layout/), hooks/ (TanStack Query), pages/ (inventory/, crm/, procurement/, sales/, reports/, ai/, settings/, auth/), services/ (ai/, excel/), types/ (database.ts), lib/ (supabase.ts, utils.ts), contexts/.
